o.text: From Proto-Turkic. Cognate with Crimean Tatar nege, Tatar нигә (nigä), Bashkir ниңә (neñä), Uyghur نەگە (nege).
Internationalism; via Russian техноло́гия (texnológija), from Ancient Greek τεχνολογία (tekhnología, “systematic treatment (of grammar)”).

Inherited from Old Anatolian Turkish بهادر (bähādur), from Persian بهادر, from Middle Mongol ᠪᠠᠭ᠋ᠠᠲᠤᠷ (baɣatur). See Proto-Turkic *bagatur for more.
Cognates
Turkic cognates:
Chuvash паттӑр (pattăr) (probably from Kipchak);
Tuvan маадыр (maadır),
Uzbek bahodir,
Tatar батыр (batır),
Turkish batur (“batır”),
Kyrgyz баатыр (baatır),
Kazakh батыр (batır),
Bashkir матур (matur),
Tatar матур (matur, “beautiful”).
Old Turkic 𐰉𐱃𐰆𐰺 (b¹t¹wr¹ /⁠batur⁠/)
Gagauz batır
Iranic cognates: Persian بهادر, Ossetian бӕгъатыр (bæǧatyr).
From English (air) conditioner, via Russian кондиционер (kondicioner).
Borrowed from Russian гидроэнергетика (gidroenergetika). By surface analysis, hidro- + energetika.
